text.p: Hungarian plastics group Pannonplast Rt said on Friday that it has acquired full control of Kaposplast Ltd.
"The company's activity fits well in those of the member companies of Pannonplast Group," Pannonplast said in a statement. No financial details were released.
Kaposplast is a plastics processing company, using PP and PE and other special plastics materials, it said.
The company's main products are PP straps for closing cardboard boxes and crates and other kinds of fasteners.

The company also produces monofilaments for cordon tapes, binding materials, cords, ropes and nets, as well as fibrous materials and bristles for brushes. It also makes microseparator sheets for batteries.

Kaposplast's sales in 1995 reached 656 million forints, while its operating profit was 40 million, the statement said. Its exports exceeded 40 percent of total sales with west Europe as the main export market, it said.
Kaposplast's market position both in Hungary and abroad is stable and developing, it said, adding that new investments and development projects were imminent.
Separately, Pannonplast announced that a local court registered a subsidiary which was set up by Pannonpipe Kft -- a group unit with 50 percent Pannonplast stake -- in Romania.
"The first step of the company operating in Cluj will be to sell and distribute the products of Pannonpipe from September," it said. "It is also aiming to start up local manufacturing later."
On Thursday on the Budapest Stock Exchange Pannonplast closed at a new high 4,700 forints, up 150.
